description: This is a unit test class for the ModifyThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl class. It includes various test cases to verify the correct construction of LiveCommandAnswer objects with different response and event configurations, mocking dependencies with Mockito.

classes.name: ModifyThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImplTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ModifyThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl, testing its response and event building methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by configuring mock command behavior and creating an instance of the builder under test.

methods.name: tryToGetNewInstanceWithNullCommand
methods.description: Verifies that passing null to the static factory method throws a NullPointerException with the appropriate message.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithModifyThingCreatedResponseOnly
methods.description: Tests building a LiveCommandAnswer with a created response and no event.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithModifyThingModifiedResponseOnly
methods.description: Tests building a LiveCommandAnswer with a modified response and no event.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithThingNotAccessibleErrorResponseOnly
methods.description: Tests building a LiveCommandAnswer representing a ‘not accessible’ error response.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithThingNotModifiableErrorResponseOnly
methods.description: Tests building a LiveCommandAnswer representing a ‘not modifiable’ error response.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithThingCreatedEventOnly
methods.description: Tests building a LiveCommandAnswer with a created event only.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithThingModifiedEventOnly
methods.description: Tests building a LiveCommandAnswer with a modified event only.
